FOR OUR CHILDREN
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer

scenes.a: Your quiet prayer for your child is remembered.
Scripture records in First Samuel chapter one:
scenes.sub: THE WORD OF GOD FOR YOUR HOME

scenes.a: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD.
And he worshipped the LORD there.
Lord, we surrender our children into your faithful hands.
Protect their steps, guard their hearts, and guide their path through every season.
Give us wisdom as parents to trust your promise when worry fills our home.
Amen. Your quiet prayer for your child is remembered.
scenes.sub: COVER YOUR HOME IN FAITHFUL PRAYER
